findings.title: /opsx:onboard non-emission scope-enforcement may be lost in rewrite
findings.details: Current SKILL.md has # Orbit additions section asserting /opsx:onboard does NOT emit (per orbit-run-summary-emit Emit scope). Task 4.1 deletes existing content; new 100% orbit-authored body has no provision for re-stating this.
findings.recommendation: Add task to chunk 4 to preserve non-emission note in new SKILL.md OR document in design.md that non-emission is enforced solely by orbit-run-summary-emit spec.

findings.title: README pre-pegging framings not swept by current tasks
findings.details: Contains 'upstream skills + feedback' / '11 upstream + 4 orbit' / similar pre-pegging accounting. Tasks 2.3-2.5 handle install-order/table-counts/sync-specs from #6 body but don't sweep these other framings.
findings.recommendation: Add task to chunk 2 (or expand 1.3) — sweep README for all references to 'upstream skills' / pre-pegging accounting, rewrite under post-pegging framing per orbit-conventions Overlay file disposition.

findings.title: Cross-chunk coupling (chunks 1-2 → chunk 3) not declared in tasks.md
findings.details: Chunks 1-2 update README narrative containing references to 'feedback' skill that chunk 3 deletes. Current chunking implies strict 1→2→3 DAG; actual dependency is 3-before-references-to-3.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) reorder chunks to 3→1→2, (b) explicitly note in chunk 1 preamble that README updates must account for chunk 3 deletion, or (c) add cross-chunk verification task at chunk 2 end.

findings.title: Task 2.4 too narrow — table-counts is symptom of bigger framing issue
findings.details: Table-counts issue is symptomatic of pre-pegging 'upstream-vs-orbit' framing (F2). Treating as counts-only misses structural reframe.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite 2.4 to focus on framing reframe (orbit overlay surface, per orbit-conventions Overlay file disposition); count correction is consequent.

findings.title: Task 4.4 (canonical-flow walkthrough) too concentrated
findings.details: 9 phases + lens intro (2 touches) + external-review demo packed into one task. High writing volume risks skipped phases or inconsistent paragraph depth.
findings.recommendation: Split into 4.4a (phases 1-4), 4.4b (phases 5-9), 4.4c (lens intro + external-review demo woven). OR add explicit per-phase checklist within the single task.

findings.title: Upstream gap (non-interactive expanded-profile) not tracked
findings.details: Task references the upstream-gap but no follow-up issue exists on Fission-AI/OpenSpec yet. #6 body said 'happy to file separately' — no such issue.
findings.recommendation: Add task to chunk 5 — file issue on Fission-AI/OpenSpec for non-interactive expanded-profile gap; reference in README as known limitation with upstream issue link.

findings.title: Spec couples quick-reference table to Overlay file disposition (maintenance burden)
findings.details: Spec requires table show origin (orbit-authored / orbit-modified / upstream-primitive). Couples SKILL.md to orbit-conventions Overlay file disposition. Every reclassification (e.g., Option 2 work) requires lockstep table update.
findings.recommendation: Consider whether origin column is necessary OR could be a link to orbit-conventions (single source of truth) rather than duplicated content. Decision before locking spec.

findings.title: (suppressed) feedback skill refs in onboard files
findings.details: Original concern: onboard.md and SKILL.md reference 'feedback' (per grep) suggesting cleanup needed when feedback skill deleted. INVESTIGATION: both references are the prose word 'approval/feedback', NOT references to the feedback SKILL. No cleanup needed.
findings.evidence: grep -n 'feedback' on both files showed exclusively the 'approval/feedback' prose context

findings.title: Cross-reference verification passed
findings.details: orbit-onboard spec references orbit-conventions Upstream version pinning + Distribution model. Names match exactly. Logged for completeness.
findings.recommendation: No action; flagged so future-edits know to re-verify if requirement names change.

findings.title: Proposal Impact list omits README troubleshooting/install-verification scope
findings.details: Impact says 'Documentation: CLAUDE.md, README, and orbit narrative docs require coordinated rewriting' but doesn't enumerate specific README sections (troubleshooting around L969, install verification table) needing updates per the reframe.
findings.recommendation: Add sub-bullet enumerating: README install instructions, install verification table, troubleshooting section, any prose referencing pre-pegging upstream/orbit accounting.

findings.title: No explicit openspec validate --strict task before user-validation
findings.details: Chunk 5 has issue closures (5.1, 5.2) + user-validation (5.3-5.5). No explicit openspec validate --strict step. /opsx:verify runs this naturally but explicit task helps document the gate.
findings.recommendation: Optional — add 5.0 'Run openspec validate lean-overlay-and-add-orbit-onboard --strict; resolve any validation findings before user-validation handoff.'

pushback_verification: All 11 findings verified against current artifact state at review-time. 1 finding (F8) flagged for pushback after initial signal showed potential 'feedback' references in onboard files — investigation revealed prose 'approval/feedback', not skill references. F8 suppressed with evidence.
final_assessment: 3 CRITICAL findings — proposal NOT ready for /opsx:apply. Findings concentrate on: (a) coverage gaps in tasks (F1 non-emission preservation, F2 README pre-pegging sweep) and (b) sequencing coherence (F3 chunk coupling). WARNINGs concentrate on writing-task concentration (F5) and minor scope/spec questions (F4, F6, F7). Once CRITICAL findings resolved, recommend re-review or proceed to apply.
